1.title: Probe begins into why Amazon cargo plane overran Miami runway
1.summary: Five people are dead and five others injured after an aircraft overran the runway, hit vehicles and caught fire.

2.title: What to Know About Amazon Air Cargo Carrier Involved in Miami Crash
2.summary: Amazon’s cargo carrier contracts out its flights and is a key part of its worldwide shipping operation. The plane that crashed in Miami on Sunday was operated by 21 Air.

3.title: As Gas Prices Soar, These Drivers Squeeze Every Mile From Every Gallon
3.summary: Gas prices have risen sharply since the start of the Iran war. Some drivers are using special techniques to maximize their miles per gallon and save at the pump.

4.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
4.summary: The far-right party is trying to form a government in the state after falling three seats short of a majority.

5.title: They Went to Ukraine on the ‘Peace Express.’ Detours Are Likely Ahead.
5.summary: The Trump administration had let the peace process enter such a freeze that a trip to Kyiv was just an initial step. Any new talks will happen alongside escalating fighting.

6.title: Rescuers dig through debris as seven dead in building collapse in Delhi
6.summary: It's not clear how many people were inside the building - or if there are still people under the debris.
